title: 22.2: An 850µW 2-to-5GHz Jitter-Filtering and Instant-Toggling Injection-Locked Quadrature-Clock Generator for Low-Power Clock Distribution in HBM Interfaces
problem: HBM (high-bandwidth memory) interfaces require parallel distribution of four quadrature clocks across multiple data groups, consuming significant power, introducing quadrature error, and suffering power-supply-induced jitter during long routings.
method: Injection-locked quadrature-clock generator operating at 2-5GHz with jitter filtering and instant-toggling capability, distributed across DQ groups to locally generate quadrature clocks from differential WDQS reference.

title: 17.3 A 30.4GOPS/mW MK-CKKS Processor for Secure Multi-Party Computation
problem: Multi-key fully homomorphic encryption (MK-FHE) processors for secure multi-party computation face challenges in integrating flexible configuration of task-, ciphertext-, and polynomial-level operations into a single area-efficient hardware architecture that scales to an unlimited number of parties.
method: The processor implements a flexible, scalable architecture for MK-CKKS that supports variable task-level configurations (linear/nonlinear transformations) composed from ciphertext-level operations (multiplication, key-switching, rescaling) and polynomial-level operations (NTT, base conversion, permutations) optimized for area efficiency.
